India-US Joint Military Exercise 'Yudh Abhyas' Begins

The annual India-US joint military exercise, 'Yudh Abhyas 2026', has commenced with simultaneous drills in Uttarakhand and Rajasthan. The exercise involves simultaneous training in Auli, Uttarakhand, and Mahajan, Rajasthan. This year's drills are reportedly focusing on the use of drones and autonomous systems.
